origin.author: jmeter-rs project
origin.description: Hand-authored bounded JMX, property, and expectation schemas for the Apache JMeter 5.6.3 distributed/RMI boundary. Worker data probes, a worker-local classpath marker, client decoys, certificates, logs, JTLs, and runner code are deliberately kept separate from runtime evidence. SSL name/value pairs use typed protected path and secret references with explicit -D<name>=<value> materialization and cleanup contracts.
origin.change_note: Corrected sender coverage to the nine selectable factory aliases, added Hold class-load/FQCN-constructor negatives, lowercase and unknown/empty mode contracts, client/server property ownership, and marked Asynch/StrippedAsynch end-of-test ordering as source observation rather than completion proof until a positive SenderDrainProof hook exists. Added callback/delivered-event ordinal domains, lifecycle overload and ProcessBatch delivery-kind descriptors, event/byte EventAck counts, closed terminal accounting, typed retry dispositions, replaced SSL literals with protected channel references, and refreshed SHA-256 provenance; no oracle execution was performed.

runtime.os_image: Ubuntu 24.04 (noble), Linux x86_64; static validation only
runtime.hostname_policy: loopback-only; hostname output is normalized and not asserted
runtime.jmeter_classpath: not executed; an external run must provision the profile-pinned Apache JMeter 5.6.3 distribution (SHA-512 checked; PGP verification required before oracle use)

fixture_origin.worker_data: Original seed files are committed under inputs/worker-a and inputs/worker-b; an external runner must stage each distinct one-line value in its corresponding worker root. Client decoys are retained separately and must not be staged on workers.
fixture_origin.dependency_inputs: The committed fixture-dependency.marker and worker-classpath probe are harmless text provenance markers referenced by the JMX CSVDataSet/classpath fields; no JAR, plugin, or executable dependency is transferred or redistributed.
fixture_origin.keystores: Not committed; inputs/ssl/README.md records typed protected JKS path/secret channels, store type, alias, and certificate identities; an external runner must generate temporary stores with the pinned JDK keytool, resolve them only inside the isolated run root, and erase resolved material during cleanup.
fixture_origin.jtl_and_logs: Not committed; raw run roots are local evidence only.
fixture_origin.runner: Not materialized in this static corpus; no shell runner, cleanup command, Java process, or network operation is part of this change.

oracle_execution.reason: The pinned Java/JMeter runtime is not provisioned for this task, and the task is restricted to safe static inputs. The profile remains external/planned as declared.

startup_retry_properties.attempt_semantics: one initial attempt plus two retries

distributed_boundary.data_transfer_rule: JMX is sent to every worker; worker-local files and dependencies are references only.
